issues.text: Carried from round 2 (originally round 1). Section 3 (and summary line 2) teaches web-platform behaviour of localStorage (string values, one store per scheme/host/port, survives reload and tab close, browser-set limit) for which content/versions.yaml has no key and refs/ has no copy. Claims 1-3 have no version_key and no allowed docs root, so they stay unverified. DECISIONS.md (2026-10-06, item (a)) still waits for the owner to add `standards.html`.
issues.quote: the browser's store of string values by key for one web address (scheme, such as `http` or `https`, host and port); the values survive a page reload and closing the tab, and the browser limits how much one address may keep
issues.fix: No text change by the writer. The owner adds `standards.html` (html.spec.whatwg.org, Web storage) to content/versions.yaml and the WebFetch allowlist. Then the writer sets version_key on claims 1-3 and 11, and review 04 is re-run for those claims.
